reason: Repair-1 reduces the initial large chipped-looking dark patches while preserving all readable copy and layout. Repair-2 makes larger loop-like texture more conspicuous in the key head center without removing pervasive metal texture; it is therefore not preferred merely because it is newer.

selected_residuals.location: Upper lever grip and protected neck; lower key head center
selected_residuals.observation: Dark flaking-looking islands are reduced, but closely spaced wavy scratch/etch marks still cover almost every part of the grip and head, including protected areas. Both surfaces now have similar fine pattern scale.
selected_residuals.impact: The broad smooth touched patch versus narrow smooth touched rim is still less distinct than specified.

selected_residuals.location: Lower cylinder face and outer plate
selected_residuals.observation: Dense scratch lines occupy much of the cylinder and plate, making protective and touched areas similarly weathered.
selected_residuals.impact: Material finish competes with the contact-specific interpretation.

selected_residuals.location: Central information area, detailed visit information
selected_residuals.observation: The large title and both objects remain evident; small detail text is comfortable at usage720 and less comfortable at thumbnail size.
selected_residuals.impact: All-detail readability is attested at usage720, not every possible display size.

limits: Fine wavy finish remains too pervasive for fully isolated smooth hand-contact wear.
